newsitem.title: USA: Horizon Pharmacies completes initial offer.
newsitem.headline: Horizon Pharmacies completes initial offer.

text.p: Horizon Pharmacies Inc Friday completed an initial public offering of 180,000 shares at $5.00 a share, according to Capital West Securities.
The net proceeds from the initial public offering and exercise of an over-allotment will be used for acquisitions, for repayment of debt, and for working capital and general corporate purposes.

Horizon Pharmacies acquires free-standing full-service retail pharmacies primarily located in communities having populations of fewer than 50,000 persons. The company owns and operates 14 retail pharmacies and plans to acquire between eight and 12 pharmacies this year.
